ai_intro: Proofs of concept (PoCs) of applied AI and agentic systems. I combine LLMs, RAG, and cloud-native infrastructure to turn business data into conversational and decision-support tools — designed from day one with measurable quality, cost, and security.

ai_pocs.title: Agentic System ChatBot
ai_pocs.description: I developed a functional PoC of an Agentic System that was a conversational ChatBot to support back-office tasks in eCommerce business in Chile.
use_cases: Company staff can use the chatbot to manage online store orders and stock requests to suppliers, receive low-stock alerts, and much more.
benefits: Customer service SLAs reduced by ~55% before and after purchase.

ai_pocs.title: AI Agent for Car Insurance Rates
ai_pocs.description: I developed a functional PoC Agentic System in Google Colab that response to user asks about business operations and using an Excel as information source.
use_cases: AI Agent can response your asks about car insurance and where this information, such as business rules, rates, and insurance coverage, is private and is typically managed using an Excel spreadsheet.

Is posible using and integrating RAG Tools, HF Inference API for use an madure LLM model A mature LLM model, which understands human conversations and their contexts very well, accesses a private resource, in this use case an Excel file with commercial information from the auto insurance service.
benefits: Sales executives stop searching through spreadsheets and get answers in seconds.
Removes the dependency on a single person knowing the business rules by heart.
Runs on the Excel and Google Workspace files you already use — fast to adopt, no complex migration.

results.project: Development and delivery of the Back-Office System
results.desc: Reduced the online store sales workflow SLA by ≈56%, increased AOV by ≈30%, and cut the online channel's operational workload by ≈60% — all within a two-month timeframe — by developing and delivering a Back-Office System to support business operations.
results.desc2: UX improvements, business stability (SRE) and costs (FinOps): 95% of user requests to the back-office system are resolved in under a third of a second (P95 latency ≈345ms), and P99 latency was optimized to ≈0.6s — so even during peak times like Black Friday the system responds in just over half a second. Over 99.9% availability for the channel integrated with the online store ensured full operational continuity during business hours, and the Total Cost of Ownership (TCO) was reduced by ≈30% by optimizing monthly IT investment to pay strictly for the exact seconds of system usage.

results.project: Development and delivery of the MVP Web App
results.desc: Reduced the MVP's time-to-market (TTM) by ≈35% by creating a DevSecOps CI/CD pipeline during the development and deployment of a Monitoring System for irrigation canals in Chile.
results.desc2: Reduced the Total Cost of Ownership (TCO) and monthly cloud provider costs by ≈45% by implementing auto-scaling based on the volume of active app users, adopting a pay-per-use model for computing power, and utilizing the cloud provider's serverless execution model.

results.project: Development and delivery of the custom Web App ERP System
results.desc: Reduced the air conditioning maintenance SLA for group clients from 2 hours to 30 minutes — covering the entire process from request to service delivery — and cut the workload by ≈40% regarding work order (WO) management, inventory control (equipment and supplies), and technician scheduling/assignment, by developing and deploying a custom web-based SPA integrated with the ERP system.
